roles.assessment: Engineering is plausible but unvalidated. Simulation is reproducible (equations + inputs stored). Fail-safe architecture (FS1+FS3) provides redundant drainage preservation. Manufacturing is feasible with standard materials. However: no in vitro data, no chronic animal data, eShunt dimensions are estimates. The engineering package is honest but incomplete — it explicitly labels everything MODEL_SUPPORTED.

Clinical hypothesis (therapeutic retention while draining CSF) is sound. 102 SURVIVES on primary claims — good for novelty. 103 is UNCERTAIN — motivation evidence found in US11850390B2, combination specificity may or may not save it. Regulatory pathway is uncertain (Class III assumed, PMA status not verified). The IP foundation is PROVEN for 102 but UNCERTAIN for 103. Patent counsel opinion is the critical next step.

Build cost ($13.5M, 4 years) is significant but justifiable for a platform technology. Acquisition time advantage (24 months) is real. IP moat is PARTIAL — 102 PROVEN but 103 UNCERTAIN. The moat requires continuation claims that don't exist yet. Without patent counsel opinion, we cannot quantify IP risk. The engineering/safety case is honest but requires physical validation. This is a credible WOULD_CONSIDER — not a BUYER_READY, not a WOULD_NOT_PAY.
